summary: An unreleased build's engine stamp carries a digest of the embedded built-in facts, so a lock snapshotted before a built-in moved reads as another engine's
acceptance: a lock stamped `<release>+unreleased` with a divergent built-in row reads that row as the embedded built-in with a re-emit finding; cargo test green
tests: a lock stamped with the bare unreleased mark reads a divergent built-in row as stale
notes: 0117 amendment; option 1 of LOAD-MOMENT's park note. Digest moves only when built-in facts do (src/builtin_lock.toml is the embedded snapshot), so committed locks stay byte-stable otherwise. Human half after ship: re-emit .temper/lock.toml (outside build's fence), as after c1a347cc.
